title: Do you trust yourself?
html:
Do you trust yourself? Take a second to think about that question… Do you really trust yourself?

By ‘yourself’, I mean your intuition. We are educated not to trust our intuition or listen to our gut feelings. However, if we do listen to our gut, and trust what it is telling us, it usually turns out to be right.

Over time we build up a reservoir of knowledge that our subconscious zips through in an instant, giving us an answer before we can think of one. What we do is often confuse the situation by thinking.

If you have ever done martial arts, you will know that you spend hours, weeks, months and years punching and kicking in unison. What that is doing is building muscle memory so that, if you are in a situation that requires force, you will act instinctively and punch and kick without having to think.

Your gut feelings come from this reservoir of knowledge and are instinctive; you don't need to think. The more you listen and use them, the better your intuition will be.

Have a terrific week and take the time to listen to yourself. You might be pleasantly surprised.
